svg.title: How the sessions of a fleet talk
svg.desc: Animated diagram of fleet site-docs in ~/projects/site, with workers docs-T1 (install page), docs-T2 (quickstart) and docs-T3 (link check) and a reference session around mike's record of the run, which holds every edit, commit, check result, note and message with who made it. docs-T2 asks what_changed and learns that docs-T1 committed install.md 2 minutes ago without reading git status. docs-T2 asks task:T1 "Is mise still second?"; the question goes to whichever session holds T1, docs-T1 answers, and docs-T2 is told once. A message to idle docs-T3 wakes it: mike pushes the mail in over its mike channel, or over Remote Control, or on its next request. docs-T1 writes a decision note, "Homebrew, then mise, then archive", which docs-T3 later reads with list_session_notes instead of asking. A check that fails in quickstart.md is sent only to docs-T2, the file's owner. docs-T1 and docs-T3 both ran npm run build for over 5 seconds, so mike introduces them to reuse one result. A question blocked for 5 minutes goes to the reference session, which answers with a file and a line.

g.text: Ask what changed instead of reading git status
docs-T2 calls what_changed, and mike answers from its record:
Ask the session that holds a task
docs-T2 asks task:T1 "Is mise still second?". mike sends it to whichever
session holds T1. docs-T1 answers, and docs-T2 is told once.
A message wakes a session that is idle
docs-T1 mails docs-T3, which is idle. mike pushes the mail into it over its
mike channel; without one, over Remote Control, or else on its next request.
A decision note is read instead of asked
docs-T1 writes a decision note: "Homebrew, then mise, then archive".
Later docs-T3 reads it with list_session_notes and asks no one.
A failed check goes to the file's owner
The check fails in quickstart.md. mike tells docs-T2, which owns that file,
and does not interrupt docs-T1 or docs-T3.
Two sessions running the same slow command
docs-T1 and docs-T3 both ran npm run build, each for over 5 seconds.
mike introduces them, so one can reuse the other's result.
A blocked question goes to the reference session
docs-T2's question has been blocked for 5 minutes, so mike sends it to
the reference session, which answers with a file and a line.
